payload.title: File:"Hybodus" cuspidatus & Lissodus fin and cephalic spines from Bonenburg.webp
payload.artist_html: Thomas P. Vida, Jürgen Kriwet and Thomas Martin
payload.description_html: Hybodontiform fin and cephalic spines. a Lissodus dorsal spine, lateral view (WMNM 4268). b1 ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus fin spine, lateral view (WMNM P97932). b2 Latimeriid skull element found cemented to spine. c ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus fin spine, posterior view (WMNM P113118). d ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus cephalic spine morphotype 1, posterior lobe present, dorsal view (1), lateral view (2) (WMNM P97690). e ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus cephalic spine morphotype 1, posterior lobe missing, dorsal view (1), lateral view (2) (WMNM P113102). f ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus cephalic spine morphotype 2, dorsal view (1), lateral view (2) (WMNM P97688). g ‘Hybodus’ cuspidatus cephalic cusp, lateral view (WMNM P97665). h Lissodus minimus cephalic spine, dorsal view (1), lateral view (2) (WMNM P113101)
